nativeZh: n. 焦虑, 忧虑, 令人焦虑的事

senses.en: (psychiatry) a relatively permanent state of worry and nervousness occurring in a variety of mental disorders, usually accompanied by compulsive behavior or attacks of panic
senses.zh: (精神病)一种在各种精神紊乱中发生的相对永久的焦虑和紧张状态,通常伴随着强迫行为或恐慌的爆发.

senses.en: a vague unpleasant emotion that is experienced in anticipation of some (usually ill-defined) misfortune
senses.zh: 一种模糊的不愉快的情绪,在预感一些(通常定义不明)的不幸时会经历.

phrases.zh: 一种焦虑症,其特征是长期自由浮动的焦虑症,以及持续了六个月以上的紧张症或出汗、颤抖或轻头痛或烦躁症等症状。
phrases.definition: an anxiety disorder characterized by chronic free-floating anxiety and such symptoms as tension or sweating or trembling or lightheadedness or irritability etc that has lasted for more than six months
